personality_one_liner: A precision-engineered verification and compliance platform built for field agents and bank supervisors with uncompromising trust and clarity.

spacing.rule: Generous touch targets, 16px padding on main containers, 8px gaps for structured data cards.

do's: Use frosted glass on sticky headers and bottom navigation over scrolling case lists
dont's: Never apply blur to form inputs or dense table cells

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Secure agent authentication with forced password change on first login.

states.empty: Enter Agent ID and password provided by CheckSphere admin.
states.error: Invalid credentials or account suspended. Contact supervisor.

screens.layout: Clean card container centered with botanical botanical deep green accent buttons and clear feedback.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Field agent overview of assigned cases, due today, overdue, sync status, and quick stats.

states.empty: No cases assigned for today. Check supervisor dispatch queue.
states.error: Failed to sync cases. Check connection or use offline mode.

screens.layout: Sticky header with sync badge, status KPI counter cards, priority list of due verifications with geo-tag indicators.

screens.name: CaseList
screens.purpose: Searchable and filterable list of all cases (assigned, drafts, returned, submitted).

states.empty: No cases match the selected filter criteria.
states.error: Unable to load case records. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Top segmented tabs, search bar with client/branch filters, vertical list of structured case cards with status pills.

screens.name: CaseDetail
screens.purpose: Comprehensive view of applicant details, address, verification type, and report initiation.
screens.layout: Header banner with client badge, applicant profile card, address block with map preview button, and sticky Start Verification primary CTA.

screens.name: FieldVerificationForm
screens.purpose: Structured verification report capturing GPS coordinates, mandatory in-app camera photos, remarks, and declaration.

states.loading: Initializing secure camera and GPS sensors...
states.empty: Complete mandatory checklist items before submission.
states.error: GPS lock required within 100 meters of target address.

screens.layout: Step-by-step collapsible checklist sections (Residence/Office/KYC), GPS coordinate validation stamp, in-app camera capture slots (Exterior, Selfie, Document), and legal declaration toggle.

screens.name: AdminWebDashboard
screens.purpose: Responsive web dashboard for supervisors and super admins with KPIs, map view, and audit trails.

states.empty: No verification records available for selected date range.

screens.layout: Sidebar navigation, top KPI summary grid (Total, TAT, Approved, Exceptions), interactive map view with exception pins, and case review table with data masking.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build CheckSphere as a secure, offline-first field verification app and responsive supervisor web dashboard in Expo React Native.
Enforce strict GPS geolocation capture and in-app camera mandatory evidence capture (gallery uploads blocked for photos).
Ensure all sensitive data (Aadhaar, PAN, Bank account numbers) are masked in UI views.
Implement forced password change on first agent login.
Provide robust offline drafts storage and automatic sync queue indicator.
Ensure sticky primary CTAs and generous touch targets across all mobile screens.
